candidates.review_text:
My husband and I went to Philly last weekend and we happen to try this restaurant. Our B&B owner also recommended that place to us. So we thought to give it a try. When we went we were very skeptical (especially me)about how the food would be.
We ordered our Samosa Chaat, believe me it was yumm!!! No exaggeration  at all. The green dip(chutney) was icing on the cake.The portion was appropriate and the samosa was cooked perfect. The best I had till now in United States. Then, we ordered Chicken Pakora; again  mind blowing. It was delicious. No one has cooked chicken pakora tht well in Ohio. If u guys go there do try that one.
Then comes the main course; we ordered Chicken Biryani and Lamb Chops Lahori. The lamb chops were perfectly cooked .Though I am not a great lamb fan,I still enjoyed every bite of it. 
I am not very sure why people are complaining abt they serving small portions(probably it was earlier). But I think it was just perfect when we went.
We were very delighted after eating there and didn't have any problems with the service. They made sure that we were liking and enjoying their food. 
I would definitely recommend people to visit them and have a great meal.
Great restaurant. Very hospitable staff. Great food with huge portions! Also very good for large groups. It's not a huge place but there were a few large parties.
Incredible meals with huge portions... We should have shared, but we were more than happy to take home all the leftovers for later.

(3.5 stars, really)

Tres tres francais, MAIS tres tres petit.

In other words, the flavors and the quality of the food were excellent and true to french cuisine.  Very well prepared and executed extremely beautifully.  HOWEVER, the restaurant and portions were extremely small.  What does this mean?

Small restaurant = feels like every other byob in philadelphia.  Cramped space, door to bathroom in the dining room which swing right open for a view of the toilet from the tables, and decor from ikea.

Small portions = $26 for 2 minuscule medallions of veal in my entree?   Please.  

I'm not a huge-portion type of person, but I also have a minimum threshold below which I find portion size to be ridiculous and offensive.

Had to go to whole foods afterwards and get a snack -- and this was after an appetizer, entree, and a shared dessert.
Very flavorful, delicious food! Very large portions! The lady who works there is very nice and will give you suggestions if you are unsure what to get. Good bang for your buck!

We ordered the broccoli rabe, the garlic bread, bucatini, angilotti, cannelloni, tiramisu, cannoli, and puff pastry. Everything was fantastic. Not just good. Not just great. Genuinely fantastic.

I read some of the other reviews. Some of the negative ones complained about a few things: crowded-loud and small portions. Crowded? Sure, but I didn't mind. I hate restaurants that are too loud, but somehow this wasn't. I'm not sure how? But I was charmed as soon as I was seated. As for the portion sizes, they were more than generous. No one in our party could finish their meals. Even the appetizers were generously sized.

We had an 8:15 reservation, but we were not seated until 8:30. But it is worth mentioning that this was not because the service was slow, but because every table was full and the patrons were slow too leave. Once seated, the service was not just attentive but charming.

We will be returning.

Good food and large portions for the entrees.   The food is something you won't find anywhere else and I enjoyed it very much.  I like the ambience as was in the darker side so it was good for a date.  The waiting staff also really knew there stuff when it came to questions about the food.

Had an excellent meal here on Friday night with my wife and another couple. We shared several appetizers and entrees and had more tha our fair share of drinks. Overall a great experience with a nice ambiance. Portion vs price is my only issue as they present themselves as hAving large portions which I definitely do not think they have.

Food for the most part was very very good. Small portions of course but many plates. It's about taste so law of diminishing returns applies , no more than 3 bites of each plate. 
Service was great. Only thing about the service I found odd. The owner served and explained some of the dishes. He seemed pissed off to be there . Unhappy. You couldn't hear a damn thing out of his mouth that he was explaining. I asked twice still couldn't hear. Neither could my wife and she has bionic hearing. 
Good to go for special occasions.

AMAZING food. Generous portions and generous guy! He really holds a high standard in what he serves. And the effort and time he puts into making the dish for you makes it well worth the wait. It was my first time trying after my coworkers keep raving about it and they were right!

If you're tired of Sabrinas, Greek Lady, Tap House, or any of the usual brunch spots near campus, Day by Day is your new go-to. A short and lovely walk from University City, perfectly done food, a lovely setting, and very reasonable prices.

[ vibe ]
Spacious with plenty of seating and sunlight. Lovely wood tables with lots of room. Framed artwork with no particular theme, but pretty nice anyway.

[ service ]
We had a lovely waitress with an unplaceable but sophisticated accent and a great attitude who ran us through her favourite items on the menu. Attentive without being annoying - no complaints here!

[ food ]
Everything was well-balanced, freshly prepared, and very generous in portion size. I ordered the tuna melt, which came with generous portions of fresh, well-seasoned tuna salad, tomato slices, melted havarti, all on a toasted croissant.

My friend got the stir-fry, which was also impressively flavoured without being overly greasy or heavy like you might get at a real Chinese place.

Portion sizes are huge - you'll definitely walk out full.

[ overall ]
Another reliable addition to your brunch repertoire!
What a great deal--a check for $13 for two people who ate more than our fill. Wonderfully rich broth for the soup, very generous portions. I'll be back!

Great food, great service. Small portions perfect to share and taste everything on the menu. 
Egg rolls not the greatest
Awesome food! Large portions so perfect to go there with friends! I also love how you can choose how mild or spicy you want each dish.
Great food and it comes in very generous portions. The service is great as well. I would highly recommend this restaurant.

Four trips here now, three meals. The first trip was a complete disappointment -  they sat us at a high top near the kitchen and the other party with me wanted an actual table. No reservation, no table - this, in spite of the fact that they had a nearly empty restaurant on a Sunday evening. This was fairly early on, so I'll cut them some slack and assume the manager on duty wasn't particularly experienced. 

Subsequent three trips have been better. I won't recount the menu - many others have done this already. Fantastic food, but small portions at high prices. It really just doesn't seem justified. If they lowered the prices or, better, increased the amount of food on the plate, they'd get that fifth star. The biggest problem I have with the plate size is that I barely get a taste before it's gone; I don't get to savor it. It's like torture, really. Happy hour prices are pretty decent, though. Just order double what you'd expect, which with the happy hour prices is reasonable, and you'll be good.

As to the menu itself, the descriptions are a bit misleading. It lists ingredients, but be aware that some of those ingredients will be in the sauce, so don't necessarily expect what you might have become accustomed to. When it lists edamame, for example, don't necessarily expect edamame beans; they may be pureed in the sauce on the plate. This, too, contributes to the disappointment in plate size, as I expected more solid food on the plate when reading the description.
I knew from the second the food came out  that it would be great. Has very good portion size and the workers were very nice.

BIG PORTIONS. YUMMY FOOD. 

I am not kidding when it comes to big portions, they give unbelievably LARGE portions here, one dish can be shared by TWO people and up to three if you are all small eaters. And usually when big dishes come to place, the quality of the food may be jeopardized, but this wasn't the case for here! Let me give a breakdown:

Red velvet pancakes: This was DELICIOUS. Light, smooth cream cheese filling that did not feel heavy, and feels a bit like a mix of frosting and whipped cream, in between the pancakes made syrup unnecessary for the pancakes. Every bite was sweet and delicious! 

Egg Benedict over salmon on a toast: SO GOOD. Had the perfect gooey egg yolk I wanted on a nice crunchy toast. Best combo. 

Egg Benedict over fried chicken: SO GOOD. Definitely not something you should have daily, but a little cheat day is okay. 

Green smoothie: tastes very fresh and healthy. If this is not something you like, don't get this then. But, if you're like me and like to taste fresh ingredients in a healthy smoothie, get this! 

Overall, great lively atmosphere with friendly service. Will come back again to try their other food and get their pancakes again!
Place was very small... You can hear the next table's conversation one inch from your ear. Food was mediocre. Small portions in my opinion

Don't go hungry or you'll be disappointed; very small portions, expensive, but the food was good. Those who dined with me felt the same... they should really consider expanding the portion size. I didn't get to experience the jazz parlor; that is the only thing that would bring me back.

Large restaurant
Nice environment
High Prices
Nice array of food/sauces/presentation of food
Small portions, was not filled at all. Especially with the rice.

The food was definitely flavorful and good, BUT as others have said - not sure if it's worth the cost considering the incredibly small portion sizes. And when I say small, it is VERY SMALL.  Don't come here hungry unless you're prepared to shell out a lot of money for small amounts of food. They are like tapas style portions, maybe smaller.  

Our group ordered different items off the dinner menu, 1 from the Mezze ("small plates") section and 3 from Al Ha'esh ("grilled over coals") section.

What we tried:
-The kofte : consisted of 2 meatballs (average size meatballs)
-The spicy eggplant : consisted of what seemed like a 1/2 inch thin slice of eggplant layered over about 5 small spoonfuls of couscous.  
-The duck kebab: small amount of meat
-The baked kibbe: portion is smaller than the palm of a young woman's hand 


Pros:
-Everything tasted good!
-Employees, especially the bartender, were friendly.  The bartender took the time to answer our questions about the ingredients of the food and made suggestions.
-Dishes were nicely presented

Cons:
-VERY SMALL portions!
-Expensive for the amount of food you receive

........ did not impress at all :-/

- Small portions - like really small
- Don't know what's Gluten Free, the server had no idea what I was talking about - scared
- Expensive - WHOA
- Food was so/so - came out luke warm - meh

So all in all, if you want to be over charged for small so/so food and drinks - this is your place.

This place is terrible! They seem really confused on their concept and it shows in the food. Small portions, bland flavors, boring dishes.
Only plus for me was the good chewy noodles. Other than that I was not impressed at all.

Meh, mostly bland food. Some of the portions are small too. I got a shrimp dish recently and it was a handful of shrimp in a tub of sauce, definitely not enough food to eat for dinner. Also, the last time I got food delivered they brought the wrong order. I was really rooting for this place but they fall short.

While offering tasty and eclectic choices, the prices compared to the portions were weak at the Twisted Tail. I ordered the Haddock for $20+ and it was a painfully paltry portion that would be too tiny for a child. While it was better than average and the presentation was nice,  they need to beef up the portions.

Another example was the quail. Again, quite tasty, but the portion was barely 3 bites and nothing more for $9. Presentation is over-rated and doesn't satisfy my appetite.  Portions and value are where it's at, and this place only delivers a third of the formula. The drinks menu was excellent, but I ordered an $11 glass of wine that while good was not even half a glass. Get real!  I'm a spender by nature but don't like going to places where I feel they are pinching you at every turn. You can find many places in this city that deliver much more for a $40+ meal/drink. 

Pros:
Ecletic and diverse menu
Tasty offerings
Appealing ambience

Cons:
Extremely small portions
Pricey
Service was slow, albeit friendly.

Great food - outrageously small portions. Stopped by for a special dinner with my girlfriend. The prices for everything are a bit out of control, but I knew what I was getting myself into ahead of time. Everything was tasty, but I left hungry $140 later. Wouldn't recommend it if you are looking for more than tapas sized plates.

I ordered delivery from them and my reaction can be summer up as "meh." Below average food to say the least. You overpay for tiny portions. I read reviews that said the portions were small, but I did not expect them to be this small. 

I ordered the paneer masala, chicken korma, onion kulcha, vegetable pakora, and sweet lassi. Half of the lassi was in the bag by the time it arrived. I'm also not 100% sure that my order was correct. The paneer masala was boring. That's the best way to describe it. I asked for spicy and it certainly was not.

Was disappointed did not live up to the price food was not good and small portions 
Nice setting missing on most cylinders

I am surprised to see so many good reviews. I eat a lot of Chinese food, and I found the food here to be sub-par at best. I tried the fish soup with pickled vegetables, the double cooked pork belly burger, and the pan fried pork dumplings. I took one bite of the double cooked pork belly burger and spit it out. It was all chewy fat soaked in an overly salty sauce on a dry, unappealing, dense white roll. I could not chew through it and ended up throwing the whole thing right into the trash. Next came the pan fried pork dumplings, which had a mushy, soggy wrapper filled with gristly pork. I couldn't eat these either. I then tried the fish soup. The flavor of the limited amount of broth was ok, but the whole takeout container was full of overcooked noodles that were nothing but mush. In fact, they were so soft I could not pick them up because they just disintegrated when the chopsticks touched them. There were a couple of very small flakes of fish on top which were just ok. The amount of fish was perhaps a total of two or three ounces. The rest was all mushy noodles. Take heed of the reviews that talk about the small portions and poor food quality. It was a really gross meal overall and I won't order from there again.

We waited really long for the Lunch and the Lunch platters are extremely small portions. Almost made me think that they ran out of food. Had ordered spicy but was served very mild. Others in the group had asked for lamb and they got it wrong and brought out chicken and that's after waiting for an hour.
Food was not that great. Small place not good to host big dinners. Very small portions for their prices. The best thing about this restaurant is BYOB honestly.

Service was great. Beer was great.  Food is another thing. Portions were horrible.   If you come her stuck to the bar food. Burger and Sandwiches.  My Salmon salad was the smallest portion I have ever seen.  Her salad was super small also.  Kids meals are great.  Sandwiches are a good proportion. Don't order off special menu.  Also very very tiny portions for a lot of money. Most kids meals are good. Daughters chicken pot pie was all dark meat and very fatty.   Marlton and all the other locations I have been too are much better. This was a two star or one but our service was great.

Cold food, small portions, impatient server. Overall bad time. We had a large party and the server seemed very annoyed. I'm sure this was because she knew she had a guaranteed tip due to the party size. First and last time I'll eat a this restaurant. Too pricey to be this bad. Don't believe the hype

Went here for a friend's surprise birthday party. We had the whole upstairs room for about 20-22 people which was great. The food was actually pretty good, however they were very small portions. The owner is a jerk, A pre fixe rate of $40 was pre-negotiated. They brought out apetizers which were barely enough for the group. The 4 menu items were very low end. 3 pastas and a chicken, again very light portions. They brought out a limited amount of bread. When we asked the gentleman who was waiting on us to explain the entres options, he really could not. Plus he butchered the word penne among other words calling it peenie and penny...who does not know how to say penne? Regardless, he got the owner to explain the menu items and as soon as the owner came in he barked "no substitutions" Also we were not given coffee at the end and barely any dessert. I would think that if you had such a large group of people there you would try to go somewhat above and beyond and create a good experience so they come back and bring friends and tell other friends. Instead he tried to maximize profits on this one meal. How much would a few pots of coffee, couple loafs of bread really costed? Again, food not bad, but will never go back after that.

Are we being pranked? We wanted to love this restaurant! Did chef's tasting for full table.
Please keep in mind, we are not the Karens and Kens of dining out. We are gracious, respectful patrons, as well as very generous tippers regardless of the experience/ food we receive. 

This experience was so underwhelming on so many levels, MAINLY for the price point. I've never walked away from a place feeling like I got robbed  until now. The portions were minuscule, even for a chef's tasting. There were fancy, seasonal ingredients prepared in tiny portions with odd sauces, with nothing particularly delicious or craveavble about them, and with no flow or connection from one dish to the next. 
I'll also say, the ambience was just awkward- the whole minimalist upmarket-cafeteria Phish (?!) vibe was a bit much. 

Our server was ok, although did not offer us a single word of apology or correction after we all pointed out being dissatisfied. There was an odd (slightly snobby?) vibe I got from other servers. 

It feels like a place created by hipsters for hipsters who don't care about food so much as about being seen and congratulating each other on mediocrity. Do yourself a favor and save your money for a place a bit less obnoxious, and A LOT nicer on all levels. This place is just not it. 

PS: the wine was great!

你正在为餐饮评论召回系统建立逆向评测集。输入是同一个固定特征下的一批真实 Yelp 完整评论。

当前固定特征：portion_size
中文含义：分量从很少到很多
用户希望的方向：higher
满足要求的英文含义：["The portions are large, generous, and provide plenty of food.", "Serving sizes are substantial and enough to satisfy customers."]
违反要求的英文含义：["The portions are small, tiny, skimpy, or do not provide enough food.", "Serving sizes are much smaller than customers expect."]

请从输入评论中恰好选择4条：2条明确满足要求，expected_direction=positive；2条明确违反要求，expected_direction=negative。每条评论最多使用一次。

要求：

1. query_text 必须是自然的中文找餐馆问题，只表达当前固定特征和指定方向。
2. query_text 不得出现商家名称、评论编号，也不得暗示已经知道答案。
3. requirement_text 用简短中文写清需要评论回答的要求。
4. evidence_span 必须逐字复制 review_text 中一段连续原文；不能翻译、改写、拼接或补字。
5. 原文必须能够直接证明正面或反面。泛泛的总体好评、差评、星级倾向和意思不清楚的句子不能使用。
6. 如果评论只提到相邻概念但不能证明当前特征，不要选择。
7. 4条样本的问题可以换自然说法，但不能改变指定特征和用户希望的方向。
8. 证据必须直接说明商家确实满足或违反要求。仅仅说“A比B更好/更差”、假设以后会怎样、或者只有在某个未满足条件下才成立，都不能当作明确证据。
9. 只返回下面这一种JSON结构，不要增加字段，不要返回Markdown代码块，不要解释：

{
  "drafts": [
    {
      "seed_review_id": "必须来自候选的review_id",
      "query_text": "自然中文问题",
      "requirement_text": "简短中文要求",
      "expected_direction": "positive或negative",
      "evidence_span": "从对应review_text逐字复制的连续原文"
    }
  ]
}

drafts必须恰好有4项，且必须是2项positive和2项negative。
